articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR) today announced that Mark Ibbotson will join the company as Executive Vice President and Chief Store Operations Officer, effective September 14. Ibbotson brings decades of experience leading large-scale retail operations through periods of significant transformation. Through senior leadership roles at Walmart and its former U.K. subsidiary Asda, Ibbotson built a reputation as an operations specialist and innovator in omnichannel retail. "Mark has done this work at scale, and he has done it exceptionally well," said Greg Foran, CEO of Kroger. "He knows what it takes to simplify complex operations, bring out the best in frontline teams, and build the digital and physical capabilities that win with customers. That is what we need as we accelerate our momentum and build America's Best Grocer." articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's Grocer, is helping customers eat healthier in the last few weeks of summer. Peak-season fruits and vegetables are fresher, more flavorful and more nutritious. When produce is harvested at the height of its season, it retains more of its natural vitamins, minerals and fiber than when it is picked early and transported long distances. And Kroger is making it more affordable to enjoy these nutrient-dense foods with $5 off a $20 produce purchase. What Kroger dietitians are recommending right now "The best thing about eating well in August and September is that the most nutritious foods are also the most delicious ones," said Laura Brown, MS, RD, LDN, director of nutrition at Kroger. "Peak-season produce is naturally higher in fiber, vitamins and antioxidants – and because it's so fresh, it's easy to enjoy." articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR) announced today it will host its 2026 Investor Day on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. The event will feature presentations and a question-and-answer session with members of Kroger's executive leadership team, including Greg Foran, Chief Executive Officer, and David Kennerley, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Management will provide an update on Kroger's strategic priorities and long-term financial outlook. Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only and advanced registration is required. The live webcast of the event is scheduled to begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and is expected to conclude at approximately 12:00 p.m. ET. All interested parties are invited to access the webcast at ir.kroger.com under Events Presentations . articles.summary: The Kroger Co.'s (NYSE: KR) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly dividend of 39 cents per share to be paid on December 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026. The company's quarterly dividend has grown at a 13% compounded annual growth rate since it was reinstated in 2006. The company continues to expect, subject to board approval, an increasing dividend over time. Kroger's capital allocation strategy is to use its free cash flow to invest in the business to drive long-term sustainable net earnings growth while also maintaining its current investment grade debt rating and returning capital to shareholders. The company actively balances the use of its free cash flow to achieve these goals. About Kroger The Kroger Co.
